written: 2026-11-24, before seed 43/44 validation or test results were available

candidate.residual: 6D arm residual, no gripper correction, residual scale 0.1
candidate.sac: shared rl/ SAC, autotune_alpha=False, entropy coefficient 0.01, other SACConfig defaults
candidate.training: random +-x/+-y 2cm per episode, 20000 env steps, warmup 1000 (zero residual), batch 256, UTD 1, sparse success reward

checkpoint_selection: configs/validation_rule.json (ckpt 2k-20k, +-x/+-y 2cm x 10 episodes, eval seed 1000, highest score, ties -> later)

test.pairing: episode i: reset/noise seed i, LIBERO initial state i, identical for every policy (frozen base included)

primary_policy: validation-selected checkpoint of each training seed (s<seed>_val)

primary_metrics.M2: equal-weight mean success over +-x/+-y 2cm, difference vs frozen base
primary_metrics.M3: equal-weight mean success over +-x/+-y 4cm, difference vs frozen base

primary_tests: per seed and metric (9 tests): paired sign-flip permutation test on per-episode differences d_i = mean over the metric's conditions of (residual_i - base_i), 200000 Monte Carlo sign flips (seed 0); Holm correction over the 9 tests; 95% paired bootstrap CI over episode indices (10000 resamples, seed 0)

secondary.M4: per distance: min, max and range of the four direction success rates (descriptive)
secondary.seed_variability: mean, SD and range of M1-M3 over the 3 training seeds (descriptive, n=3)

exploratory: per-condition exact McNemar vs base (27 per policy set, unadjusted, flagged exploratory)
C1 residual before/after perturbation, by direction and time after perturbation
C2 direction-conditional response using the four direction runs as branches from the identical pre-perturbation state
C3 alpha=0 wrapper sanity check (seed 42 final, 3 conditions)
post-perturbation residual ablation of each primary policy on the 8 perturbed conditions
independence_caveat: Seed 42's configuration (fixed coefficient, 6D, random direction) was chosen after inspecting test-seed (eval seed 0) results of earlier runs, so seed-42 test results are not a fully independent final test. Seeds 43/44 test results were not used for any choice.
